newsitem.title: UK: S.Korea nuclear power station to start up end-June.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea nuclear power station to start up end-June.

text.p: South Korea's 12th nuclear power station will start commercial operation at the end of June following completion on Thursday of its official commissioning process, the nuclear industry news agency NucNet said.

The agency reported the Korea Atomic Industrial Forum as saying Wolsong-2, the country's second Canadian CANDU-type pressurised heavy water reactor, successfully carried out its final continuous performance test on Thursday.
Commission of the 700 megawatt (MW) reactor means Korea's total installed capacity tops 10,000 MW for the first time, equivalent to 36 percent of total national power generation.
